description: Created heavy data skew on sales.cust_id.
expected_fix: Rebalance partitions or filter skewed keys.
reason: The customers table has the largest number of rows, and skewed data in this table could significantly affect join operations with other tables, leading to performance issues and potential errors.
expected_impact: Increased runtime by 20-50% due to inefficient data distribution, potentially exceeding the expected healthy range of ±10% and causing the baseline runtime to rise above 3.6 ms.
